description: Angular component for a string items list with autocomplete, validation, and user input handling.

classes.name: StringItemsListComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing a list of string items with autocomplete, validation, and customizable options.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes filteredValues observable if predefinedValues or fetchOptionsFn are provided.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Updates validation rules for the items control based on 'required' property.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback for when the value changes.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Registers a callback for when the control is touched.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form based on the input.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Sets the component's value from external source, updating internal state and form controls.

methods.name: addOnBlur
methods.description: Handles adding an item when input loses focus.

methods.name: addOnEnd
methods.description: Adds an item from the input event.

methods.name: removeItems
methods.description: Removes an item from the list.

methods.name: onFocus
methods.description: Handles focus event, updating validation if needed.

methods.name: displayValueFn
methods.description: Returns display string for an item.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Adds a new item based on search text, considering predefined values and fetch options.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an item to the list and updates form control.

methods.name: fetchValues
methods.description: Fetches filtered options based on search text.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the input field and resets focus.
